title: Binance Wallet Introduces Event Rush — Trade Real-World Events Like Tokens
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet  is excited to announce the launch of Event Rush, a new feature that lets you trade on the outcomes of real-world events. From sports results and crypto price targets to the latest news, Event Rush turns real-world outcomes into tradable tokens. What Is Event Rush: Powered by the 42.space protocol on BNB Chain, Event Rush is where token trading meets real-world events. It offers a dynamic trading experience where being early can be as important as being right. Each event (for example, a sports match) has a set of possible results. Each result has its own Event Meme, representing that specific result. You pick the outcome you want to trade and buy its Event Meme using USDT on BSC. Once you hold an Event Meme, you have two options: Sell before the event ends.  The price of your Event Meme moves up or down based on demand. Sell at any time to take profit. No need to wait for the event to end. Hold to settlement.  If your outcome is correct, you claim a share of the entire pool, proportional to your holdings of the total winning Event Memes. There is no upside cap. If your outcome is wrong, your Event Meme goes to zero. The earlier you buy, the more shares you receive for the same amount.  Key Features: Uncapped upside:  Winners split the full prize pool. The bigger the losing side, the bigger the potential win. Demand-driven pricing:  Token prices are set by a Bonding Curve based on trading activity, not market-set probabilities. A price always exists, no liquidity gaps on niche events. Continuous trading:  Enter and exit your position at any time before the event ends. You don't need to predict the correct outcome to make a profit. Wide event coverage:  Sports results, crypto price targets, news outcomes, and more. New events are added regularly. How to Get Started: Open Binance Wallet Head to Markets and navigate to the new [eMeme] tab Browse available events and select one that interests you Choose an Event Meme representing the result you want to trade Buy using your USDT on BSC balance and start trading Won? Tap [Claim] on the eMeme page to claim your USDT Explore Event Rush Now Notes: A Service Fee applies to every buy and sell. When selling, a Redeem Tax also applies. This is a dynamic exit fee that is higher when selling close to the event end date. Both are shown clearly in the trade confirmation screen before you confirm. Event Rush is powered by 42.space, a third-party decentralized protocol. Binance Wallet provides access to Event Rush within its interface but does not act as the market counterparty. Users are encouraged to review the 42.space documentation for further information. Eligibility: Event Rush is available to all verified Binance Wallet users. However, access may be restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions due to legal and regulatory requirements. Please refer to the platform for the most up-to-date information on availability in your region.
